objective: Compute p10/p50/p90 wind-power prediction intervals from scenario wind forecasts and a turbine power curve.

objective.en: Convert scenario weather forecasts to power and report prediction intervals for each horizon.
objective.ru: Перевести сценарные прогнозы погоды в мощность и указать прогнозные интервалы для каждого горизонта.

instructions.en: Use wind_interval_case. Power curve convention (use exactly this): corrected speed v_c = wind_speed_m_s * (air_density_kg_m3 / reference_air_density_kg_m3)^(1/3); power = 0 if v_c < cut_in_m_s or v_c >= cut_out_m_s; power = count*rated_mw_each if v_c >= rated_m_s; otherwise power = count*rated_mw_each * ((v_c - cut_in_m_s)/(rated_m_s - cut_in_m_s))^3. Quantile convention (use exactly this): sort the scenario powers ascending as x[0..n-1]; pos = q*(n-1); p_q = linear interpolation between x[floor(pos)] and x[ceil(pos)]. Report p10/p50/p90 per timestamp and average_interval_width_mw as the mean of (p90 - p10) over timestamps.
instructions.ru: Используйте wind_interval_case. Конвенция кривой мощности (используйте ровно её): скорректированная скорость v_c = wind_speed_m_s * (air_density_kg_m3 / reference_air_density_kg_m3)^(1/3); мощность = 0, если v_c < cut_in_m_s или v_c >= cut_out_m_s; мощность = count*rated_mw_each, если v_c >= rated_m_s; иначе мощность = count*rated_mw_each * ((v_c - cut_in_m_s)/(rated_m_s - cut_in_m_s))^3. Конвенция квантилей (используйте ровно её): отсортируйте мощности сценариев по возрастанию x[0..n-1]; pos = q*(n-1); p_q — линейная интерполяция между x[floor(pos)] и x[ceil(pos)]. Укажите p10/p50/p90 по каждому моменту времени и average_interval_width_mw как среднее (p90 - p10).

submission_schema.prediction_interval_mw_by_timestamp: object mapping timestamp to {p10, p50, p90}

hard_constraints: Each p10/p50/p90 value must match the independent scenario quantile calculation within 0.01 MW.
Intervals must satisfy p10 <= p50 <= p90.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether the submitted intervals satisfy all hard constraints.
